#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>

#include <vector>

#include <cstdint>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const int MOD = 998244353;

ll mod_pow(ll a, ll n, ll mod) {
    ll ret = 1;
    for (; n; n >>= 1) {
        if (n & 1) ret = ret * a % mod;
        a = a * a % mod;
    }
    return ret;
}

ll inv(ll a, ll mod) {
    ll b = mod, p = 1, q = 0;
    while (b) {
        ll c = a / b;
        ll d = a; a = b; b = d % b;
        d = p; p = q; q = d - c * q;
    }
    return p < 0 ? p + mod : p;
}

static const int NTT_PRIMES[] = {1053818881, 1051721729, 1045430273, 1012924417, 1007681537, 1004535809, 998244353, 985661441, 976224257, 975175681};
static const int NTT_ROOTS[] = {7, 6, 3, 5, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 17};

// reverse bits of x within given width (h bits)
int revbit(int x, int h) {
    int y = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < h; ++i) {
        y = (y << 1) | (x & 1);
        x >>= 1;
    }
    return y;
}

ll modh(ll a, ll M, int h, int mod) {
    const ll MASK = (1LL << 31) - 1;
    ll r = a - ((M * (a & MASK) >> 31) + M * (a >> 31) >> (h - 31)) * mod;
    return r < mod ? r : r - mod;
}

vector<ll> nttmb(const vector<ll>& src, int n, bool inverse, int P, int g) {
    vector<ll> dst = src;
    dst.resize(n, 0);
    int h = __builtin_ctz(n);
    ll K = (ll)1 << (31 - __builtin_clz(P)); // highest power of two >= P? Actually we need K = 1LL << (32 - __builtin_clz(P))? Let's compute Integer.highestOneBit(P) << 1
    // Integer.highestOneBit(P) = 1 << (31 - __builtin_clz(P))
    K = (1LL << (31 - __builtin_clz(P))) << 1;
    int H = __builtin_ctzll(K) * 2; // number of trailing zeros of K * 2
    ll M = K * K / P;
    
    vector<int> wws(1 << (h - 1));
    ll dw = inverse ? mod_pow(g, P - 1 - (P - 1) / n, P) : mod_pow(g, (P - 1) / n, P);
    ll w = (1LL << 32) % P;
    for (int k = 0; k < (1 << (h - 1)); ++k) {
        wws[k] = (int)w;
        w = modh(w * dw, M, H, P);
    }
    ll J = inv(P, 1LL << 32);
    for (int i = 0; i < h; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < (1 << i); ++j) {
            for (int k = 0, s = j << (h - i), t = s | (1 << (h - i - 1)); k < (1 << (h - i - 1)); ++k, ++s, ++t) {
                ll u = (dst[s] - dst[t] + 2 * P) * wws[k];
                dst[s] += dst[t];
                if (dst[s] >= 2 * P) dst[s] -= 2 * P;
                ll Q = (u << 32) * J >> 32;
                dst[t] = (u >> 32) - (Q * P >> 32) + P;
            }
        }
        if (i < h - 1) {
            for (int k = 0; k < (1 << (h - i - 2)); ++k) wws[k] = wws[k * 2];
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (dst[i] >= P) dst[i] -= P;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        int rev = revbit(i, h);
        if (i < rev) {
            swap(dst[i], dst[rev]);
        }
    }
    if (inverse) {
        ll in = inv(n, P);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) dst[i] = modh(dst[i] * in, M, H, P);
    }
    return dst;
}

vector<ll> convoluteSimply(const vector<ll>& a, const vector<ll>& b, int P, int g) {
    int m = max(2, (1 << (31 - __builtin_clz(max((int)a.size(), (int)b.size()) - 1))) << 2);
    vector<ll> fa = nttmb(a, m, false, P, g);
    vector<ll> fb = (&a == &b) ? fa : nttmb(b, m, false, P, g);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        fa[i] = fa[i] * fb[i] % P;
    }
    return nttmb(fa, m, true, P, g);
}

vector<ll> clean(const vector<ll>& a) {
    int i = (int)a.size() - 1;
    while (i >= 0 && a[i] == 0) i--;
    if (i < 0) return vector<ll>(0);
    if (i == (int)a.size() - 1) return a;
    return vector<ll>(a.begin(), a.begin() + i + 1);
}

vector<ll> mulnaive(const vector<ll>& a, const vector<ll>& b) {
    vector<ll> c(a.size() + b.size() - 1, 0);
    const ll BIG = 8LL * MOD * MOD;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < a.size(); ++i) {
        for (size_t j = 0; j < b.size(); ++j) {
            c[i + j] += a[i] * b[j];
            if (c[i + j] >= BIG) c[i + j] -= BIG;
        }
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < c.size(); ++i) c[i] %= MOD;
    return c;
}

int main() {
    // input
    int n, K;
    scanf("%d %d", &n, &K);
    vector<int> d(K);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) scanf("%d", &d[i]);

    vector<ll> f(20, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < K; ++j) {
            f[10 + d[i] - d[j]]++;
        }
    }

    n /= 2;
    vector<ll> g(1, 1);
    for (int D = 17; D >= 0; --D) {
        g = clean(convoluteSimply(g, g, MOD, 3));
        if (n & (1 << D)) {
            g = clean(mulnaive(g, f));
        }
    }

    int idx = n * 10;
    ll ans = (idx < (int)g.size()) ? g[idx] : 0;
    printf("%lld\n", ans);

    return 0;
}
